attributes.title: Drift
attributes.lede: A car you tune while you are driving it.

lesson.concept: A simulation and a transition have different responsibilities
lesson.why: The car's continuous driving model owns steering, grip and velocity. Choreo handles discrete changes around that world, such as arrival and rearrangement; a spring preset does not replace the driving loop.
lesson.experiment: Hold the pointer on the track, change the car's own grip controls, and drive again. Use Bouncy parking and Precision parking to compare the surrounding transitions separately.
lesson.pitfall: Calling a transition duration the car's handling parameter confuses the simulation with its presentation.
lesson.combine: Combine with a guided explanation that pauses at a reproducible driving condition rather than pretending a fresh throw is identical.
